newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish govt approves spending austerity measures.
newsitem.headline: Spanish govt approves spending austerity measures.

text.p: The Spanish government approved on Friday measures to improve the control and austerity of public spending, spokesman Miguel Angel Rodriguez said on Friday.
A program to improve and rationalise state purchases of a trillion pesetas or more will be enforced and is expected to save up to 64 billion pesetas.
Rodriguez said the government would also try to apply the program to regional governments and local corporations.
An austerity plan for the general administration to control and save on public spending on services will also come into effect.

"For the first time an austerity plan makes reference not only to central services of the state, but also to peripheral services, public companies and companies attached to the central administration," Rodriguez said at a weekly briefing.
